headlines.summary: Could artificial intelligence pose an existential threat to humanity? Some leading researchers are warning against an unregulated race toward AI superintelligence.

headlines.summary: The European Central Bank is inviting people across Europe to vote on the designs for future euro banknotes before its public survey closes on 21 September.

headlines.title: Africa s richest man Dangote s IPO out of reach in Nigeria
headlines.summary: Dangote seeks $1.6 billion from investors to finance a $14.3 billion expansion and thus double the oil refinery s capacity. The offer could give millions of Nigerians a stake in the company. But who can truly afford it?

headlines.title: Germany s embattled leader Merz cancels New York trip amid mounting domestic pressure
headlines.summary: Chancellor Friedrich Merz will instead stay in Germany to deal with fallout of elections in which his party is expected to fare badly.

headlines.title: US borrowing costs hit highest level since 2007
headlines.summary: The effective interest rate on US government bonds over 10 years, known as the 10-year Treasury yield, has risen as high as 5.04% but has eased back since.

headlines.title: China's retail sales slow again as Beijing struggles to revive consumer spending
headlines.summary: Retail sales in China grew just 0.4% in August, the slowest pace since growth resumed and the second consecutive monthly slowdown, underlining how little progress Beijing has made in reviving consumer spending even as factory output accelerates.

headlines.title: Can Iran replace sea trade with land routes?
headlines.summary: Iran is shifting trade toward northern ports and land routes as its southern shipping faces a US blockade. Analysts say the corridors can keep essential goods moving, but cannot replace maritime trade.

headlines.title: Iran war has cost US taxpayers $38B — and counting
headlines.summary: The Congressional Budget Office said the prolonged military campaign will hit $2 billion to $3 billion a month.

headlines.title: AI app ads promoting 'objectification of women' banned by watchdog
headlines.summary: The ad regulator said it had "zero-tolerance" for ads promoting AI tools that could sexualise or objectify women.

headlines.title: Canada pitches itself as a haven for investors 'in a very uncertain world'
headlines.summary: Canada is positioning itself as a refuge for global capital, with Finance Minister François-Philippe Champagne saying the country is a safe place to invest in a very uncertain world as Ottawa hosts the largest investment summit in its history.

headlines.title: Why are European banks moving gold out of United States?
headlines.summary: The Netherlands and France have moved their gold out of US vaults. Part of the reason is fears about the reliability of the US, but equally important is the need to keep gold closer to home in the event of a crisis.
